description: Stereo VCA with two amplifier models, a transistor pair and an operational transconductance amplifier, neither of them a clean multiplier and both saturating when the signal is pushed

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the amplifier before the gain is applied: low settings stay clean, high settings saturate and thicken the sound
Attenuates the control voltage that opens and closes the VCA, and with nothing patched to the CV jack it sets the gain by hand
Picks the modelled circuit: BJT is the transistor pair, which closes completely below a threshold and reaches silence; OTA is the exponential taper, which never closes fully and distorts earlier

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio input
The right channel of the audio input
The control voltage for the gain, scaled by the attenuator, despite the maker's tooltip naming it Drive

outputs.text: The left channel of the amplified signal
The right channel of the amplified signal
